candidates.statement: Verify a detached launch by looking for the PROCESS, never by reading the launcher's exit status. A backgrounded command outlives the compound statement that started it, so a launcher that reports failure is not evidence that nothing started — and the resulting double-run corruption is invisible to exit_code, elapsed time, and newline-termination checks. Where the detached work writes a transcript, assert exactly one system/init, one result, one session_id and zero malformed lines; one subject produces exactly one of each.

candidates.bank_reason: Single instance so far, and the fix applied here is arm-local (an O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock in run_all_post.py plus a transcript-integrity gate condition). Re-observe whether the shape recurs on a NON-capture detach — a crew dispatch or a background build — before promoting it into commander-core's execute-step detach guidance. A second occurrence outside measurement would make it a standing detach rule rather than a measurement one; a second occurrence INSIDE measurement would instead argue for shipping the transcript-integrity check into verify_treatment.py permanently, which is the narrower and cheaper fix.

candidates.statement: An arm measuring a corpus change must separate 'the treatment is installed' from 'the treatment reached the agent'. Verifying that a skill loaded proves only that the skill loaded; where the instruction under test lives in a template or script the skill does not itself quote, an agent can load the skill and never meet the instruction. Without an explicit delivery hop between installed and obeyed, a null is unattributable and cannot distinguish 'never delivered' from 'delivered and ignored', which are different defects with different remedies.
